_fixture.name: poll result snapshot, empty pollVotes
_fixture.semantic: An empty pollVotes array is a COMPLETE empty snapshot ('observed: no recorded option counts'), not 'unknown options' — the distinction design/02 draws between a covered empty set and an uncovered one. It also cannot settle whether the poll was invalidated; WebMessageInfo.pollAdditionalMetadata.pollInvalidated is a separate field on the message envelope, not in this payload.
